description: This Java source file defines an abstract class for command strategies related to connectivity within a messaging persistence context. It provides common functionality for handling connectivity commands, such as validation and error handling, as a base class for specific implementations.

classes.name: AbstractConnectivityCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class serving as the base for connectivity command handling strategies, encapsulating validation and error handling logic.

methods.name: AbstractConnectivityCommandStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class with a command type it handles.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Indicates whether the command is defined; always returns true in this implementation.

methods.name: calculateRelativeMetadata
methods.description: Calculates and returns optional metadata relative to the connection, here returning empty.

methods.name: notAccessible
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionNotAccessibleException with header info.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the connection and command; catches and wraps exceptions into optional runtime exceptions.

methods.name: handleValidationException
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions, logs details, and returns a wrapped DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: toDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a DittoRuntimeException, wrapping specific connection failure details.
